service.description: Refuses a public account: forum moderation in Comms is for internal staff, whatever public site they moderate.

actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.forum.ModerationServices.find#ModerationScopes').parameters({input: {}}).call()?.result || {} if (!out.internal) ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Forum moderation in Comms is for internal staff'))

service.description: The sites and bound categories the current internal user moderates, as drop-down options keyed siteId or siteId|contactListId.

actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.forum.ModerationServices.find#ModerationScopes').parameters({input: {}}).call()?.result || {} internal = !!out.internal scopeList = Array.from(out.scopeList || []).map((s) => ({key: s.siteId + (s.contactListId ? '|' + s.contactListId : ''), text: s.contactListId ? s.siteName + ' · ' + s.name : s.siteName + ' · all categories', siteId: s.siteId, contactListId: s.contactListId || null}))

service.description: Open review items in one scope, each with the title of the post or member it concerns.
One decision for several items of a site; the forum answers per item, and a failed item does not stop the rest.
